data.name: Ishanya
data.long_meaning: Ishanya is a name derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Ishana’ which signifies the deity of time and the beginning. This name holds immense significance in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the supreme power, creation, and the start of new beginnings. Ishanya is believed to be the embodiment of time, and those named after her are considered to possess the qualities of wisdom, patience, and understanding.
